questions.q: What question does Keller suggest you ask to identify your top priority?
a: What's the ONE thing I can do so everything else becomes easier?
What tasks should I delegate today?
Which project will generate the most revenue?
How can I multitask most efficiently?
questions.why: It is the focusing question described as the core concept.

questions.q: Which principle does Keller align with, stating a small input yields most results?
questions.why: He references the 80/20 or Pareto principle.

questions.q: What did Steve Jobs do to improve Apple's product line in 1997?
questions.why: Jobs said he said no 340 times, reducing to 10 products.

questions.q: According to the book, which life area is compared to a rubber ball?
questions.why: Work is described as the rubber ball that bounces back.

questions.q: What habit does the book say is essential for maintaining focus?
questions.why: Saying no is highlighted as key to focus.
